# Step - has_id

`has_id` · `hasId` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Keeps elements whose id is one of the given ids (ids are strings, see the book page Id Arguments).

## Forms

```text
has_id(arg1: any)
has_id(arg1: array)
has_id(arg1: any, arg2: any)
has_id(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has_id(1, 2).values("name").to_list()   // ["marko", "vadas"]
```

## See also

- [Id Arguments of V(), E() and hasId()](../../users_guide/id_arguments.md)
